sections.title: 引言
keyPoints: 说明参数高效适配问题和综述范围，没有本文实验。

sections.title: 低秩适配机制
keyPoints: 解释 LoRA 冻结预训练权重与可训练秩分解矩阵。

sections.title: 量化适配机制
keyPoints: 解释 QLoRA 冻结四位量化模型向低秩适配器反传梯度。

sections.title: 综合比较与局限性
keyPoints: 比较两种机制如何改变可训练对象与存储对象，不能给无证据性能排序；材料仅两篇摘要，未统一复现。

sections.title: 结论与展望
keyPoints: 总结方法关系与限制，未来跨任务评测不是已完成贡献。

source.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models

evidence.claim: We propose Low-Rank Adaptation, or LoRA, which freezes the pre-trained model weights and injects trainable rank decomposition matrices into each layer of the Transformer architecture, greatly reducing the number of trainable parameters for downstream tasks.
evidence.quote: We propose Low-Rank Adaptation, or LoRA, which freezes the pre-trained model weights and injects trainable rank decomposition matrices into each layer of the Transformer architecture, greatly reducing the number of trainable parameters for downstream tasks.
evidence.verificationMethod: public abstract exact quote; manually scoped fixture, not production judge

source.title: QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs

evidence.claim: QLoRA backpropagates gradients through a frozen, 4-bit quantized pretrained language model into Low Rank Adapters~(LoRA).
